messages.body:
Thornbury Industries Limited
CIN: L27109KA1991PLC084213
Registered Office: 14 Harbour Road, Calder City - 560001

Date: 18 August 2026

Dear Shareholder,

Subject: Communication on Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) on dividend payout

The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 15 May 2026 have recommended a final dividend of Rs. 4.50 per equity share for the financial year ended 31 March 2026, subject to approval by shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

As you are aware, the Company is required to withhold tax at the prescribed rates on dividend paid to shareholders in accordance with the Income-tax Act. The withholding rate varies depending on the residential status and category of the shareholder, and on the documents submitted by them and accepted by the Company.

A. RESIDENT SHAREHOLDERS

  1. Valid PAN registered with the Depository Participant, no exemption sought .......... 10%
  2. No PAN or invalid PAN registered .......................................................... 20%
  3. Submission of Form 15G / Form 15H, where eligible ...................................... Nil
  4. Shareholders exempt under Section 10 with supporting documentation ................. Nil

B. NON-RESIDENT SHAREHOLDERS

  1. Without valid tax residency certificate ................................................... 20% plus applicable surcharge and cess
  2. With tax residency certificate, Form 10F and no permanent establishment declaration .......... rate under the applicable tax treaty

Shareholders seeking a nil or reduced rate of withholding must upload the relevant declarations and supporting documents through the registrar's portal at https://portal.thornbury.example/tds on or before 4 September 2026. Documents received after this date cannot be considered, and tax will be deducted at the rates set out above. No physical copies are required.

A separate communication confirming the amount of tax deducted will be sent after the dividend is paid.

For queries please write to secretarial@thornbury.example quoting your folio number.

Yours faithfully,
Company Secretary
Thornbury Industries Limited

This is a system generated communication and does not require a signature.
